title: Palindrome After Cleanup
prompt:
Given a string s, decide whether it reads the same forwards and backwards after you ignore every character that is not a letter or digit and treat uppercase and lowercase letters as equal. A string with no letters or digits counts as a palindrome.

Try to solve it with two pointers and O(1) extra space.

Example:
  is_clean_palindrome("Was it a car, or a cat I saw?") -> True
  is_clean_palindrome("race a car") -> False
